title: Unstoppable Waveform!
summary:
Unstoppable Waveform!



● Morphling ($5/Element/Elf/Assassin): Upgraded from $2 to $5, and gained Elf.
● Morphling - Waveform: Reworked
● Ogre Magi ($3/Ogre/Mage):  Upgraded from $1 to $3, Multicast reworked into an aura effect.
● Meepo ($2/Kobold/Mech): Downgraded from $3 to $2.
● Magic Seed: Chances for turnips’ growing up every round is now dynamic. Chances are much higher in later games.
● Fix bugs
